title: Illustration / Duo / Please don’t
slide_intent: Set limits on expressive variation because small alterations can change a mascot’s personality or construction.
strategic_value: Avoiding centered pupils, fingers and unnecessary wing shading can preserve Duo’s familiar expression and flat form.
demonstration: Three crossed-out figures illustrate the three corresponding prohibitions listed at right.
practical_value: Check eye placement, wing silhouette and color before approving a new Duo pose.

content_islands.name: Rejected poses
content_islands.spec: Align the centered-pupil owl, fingered wing and darkened wing in three pink rejection frames.

content_islands.name: Specific prohibitions
content_islands.spec: Align the explanatory list at right, keeping the reason for each rule where supplied.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says centered pupils look creepy and correct posing makes extra wing color unnecessary.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Do not center pupils, give Duo fingers or darken wings merely because they overlap or sit behind the body.

ingredient.name: Duo drawing limits
ingredient.role: Protect the mascot’s expression and flat construction.
ingredient.application: Avoid centered pupils, fingers and extra dark wing colors used to indicate depth.
ingredient.scope: Historical Duo-specific limits; other characters have their own hand and eye guidance.
